guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.

intent.problem: The production Weekly Radar workflow and reader documentation define Monday 09:00 JST, but the reusable application scheduler defaults to Sunday and its tests/specs encode that different default. This makes the same schedule contract produce different answers depending on which boundary is used.
constraints: Treat .github/workflows/weekly-radar.yml and the runtime specification as the production schedule authority.
Align only the library default, tests, and schedule documentation; preserve explicit WeeklySchedule::new(day_of_week) behavior.
Keep the scheduler pure: it must not read time, persist data, render, publish, retry, or create a Domain dependency.
intent.rationale: Changing the default from Sunday to Monday is the smallest evidence-backed correction that removes the source-of-truth split while preserving all explicit caller configuration and production workflow behavior.
